sources.entry: SwarmClaw — Self-hosted multi-agent AI runtime. MCP client + server, 23+ LLM providers, persistent memory, skills, schedules, sub-agent spawning, and inbound connectors for Discord, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Teams, and Matrix. Electron desktop app, CLI, and Docker. MIT. → Website

summary.one_liner: SwarmClaw is a self-hosted multi-agent AI runtime that runs autonomous agents, schedules, persistent memory, MCP tools and connectors to chat platforms across 23+ LLM providers.
summary.what_it_does: SwarmClaw runs AI agents and agent swarms on your own machine or server, with a web dashboard for managing them. Agents can have heartbeats, schedules, background jobs and delegation to other agents, including CLI backends such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. The README describes durable agent memory with recall, journaling and reflection, plus runtime skills that can be imported from OpenClaw SKILL.md files and conversation-to-skill drafts that require approval. It connects to MCP servers over stdio, SSE or streamable HTTP and supports inbound connectors for Discord, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Teams, Matrix and email. Optional features include linked crypto wallets, the SwarmDock marketplace, SwarmFeed social network, and opt-in OpenTelemetry trace export.
use_cases: Run a personal assistant that remembers preferences and sends scheduled check-ins
Build a multi-agent team that delegates tasks on a shared board
Operate a support agent across Discord, Slack, Telegram and WhatsApp
Manage a fleet of OpenClaw gateways from one control plane
Run recurring research or content pipelines on a schedule
Self-host an AI agent dashboard with many LLM providers
how_to_run: git clone <repo> && cd swarmclaw && nvm use && npm run quickstart
mkdir -p data && touch .env.local && docker compose up -d --build
notable: Multi-provider support: 23+ LLM providers including Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama, OpenRouter and LM Studio, plus CLI delegation backends
Durable agent memory with hybrid recall, reflection memory and open follow-up tracking
Schedules and heartbeats with per-run delivery status written back to each schedule
Conversation-to-skill drafts that must be reviewed before entering the skill library
Desktop installer, global npm CLI and Docker image (linux/amd64 and arm64) options
caveats: Desktop macOS builds may be unsigned, requiring a manual Gatekeeper approval or quarantine removal; README says the damaged-app issue remains open until signing is configured
Docker Desktop is recommended for sandboxed browser execution, and provider CLIs are optional extras
Requires Node.js 22.6+ for source and CLI installs
